pack.name: Developer English
pack.description: Inglés técnico para desarrollar software: proceso, calidad, despliegue y operaciones.

expressions.explanation: In software, to send a feature to production. A ship is also the noun for a boat.

examples.english: We ship the new dashboard on Friday.
examples.spanish: Publicamos el nuevo panel el viernes.

examples.english: Shipping early and fixing fast beats polishing forever.
examples.spanish: Publicar pronto y corregir rápido es mejor que pulir eternamente.

expressions.explanation: To install and start a program or a service so that real users can use it.

examples.english: We deploy to production twice a week.
examples.spanish: Desplegamos a producción dos veces por semana.

examples.english: The service was deployed but never configured.
examples.spanish: El servicio se desplegó pero nunca se configuró.

expressions.explanation: To undo a change that is already live, usually to restore the previous working version.

examples.english: We rolled back the release after ten minutes.
examples.spanish: Revertimos la publicación después de diez minutos.

examples.english: If the migration fails, roll back to the previous schema.
examples.spanish: Si la migración falla, revierte al esquema anterior.

expressions.explanation: To find the cause of a problem in a program and fix it. Unlike fix, it implies looking for the reason.

examples.english: It took me a whole afternoon to debug this race condition.
examples.spanish: Me llevó una tarde entera depurar esta condición de carrera.

examples.english: Add a log line and debug it with a smaller input.
examples.spanish: Añade un log y depúralo con una entrada más pequeña.

expressions.meaning: refactorizar, reescribir el código sin cambiar su comportamiento
expressions.explanation: To improve the internal structure of code without changing what it does for users.

examples.english: We refactored the payment module to make it testable.
examples.spanish: Refactorizamos el módulo de pagos para que fuera testeable.

examples.english: Refactoring without tests is just rewriting code.
examples.spanish: Refactorizar sin tests es solo reescribir código.

expressions.explanation: The habit of having a colleague read a change before it is merged, to catch problems and share knowledge.

examples.english: Every change needs a code review before merging.
examples.spanish: Cada cambio necesita una revisión de código antes de fusionarlo.

examples.english: The code review caught an unchecked null value.
examples.spanish: La revisión de código detectó un valor nulo sin comprobar.

expressions.meaning: pull request (solicitud de fusión de cambios)
expressions.explanation: In GitHub and GitLab, a request to merge your branch into another one. In everyday English, pull request can also mean asking for something.

examples.english: Open a pull request and ask two people to review it.
examples.spanish: Abre una pull request y pide a dos personas que la revisen.

examples.english: The pull request is still waiting for approval.
examples.spanish: La pull request sigue esperando aprobación.

expressions.explanation: Git cannot join two versions of the same file automatically because both sides changed the same lines.

examples.english: I lost an hour resolving a merge conflict in the config file.
examples.spanish: Perdí una hora resolviendo un conflicto de fusión en el archivo de configuración.

examples.english: A merge conflict means somebody has to decide which version wins.
examples.spanish: Un conflicto de fusión significa que alguien tiene que decidir qué versión gana.

expressions.explanation: A change that makes existing code stop working, such as renaming a method or removing a field.

examples.english: Renaming that field would be a breaking change for our clients.
examples.spanish: Renombrar ese campo sería un cambio incompatible para nuestros clientes.

examples.english: Document every breaking change in the release notes.
examples.spanish: Documenta cada cambio incompatible en las notas de la versión.

expressions.explanation: The future cost of a quick decision made only to ship faster, like a shortcut that has to be paid back later.

examples.english: Skipping the tests was quick, but it left us with technical debt.
examples.spanish: Omitir los tests fue rápido, pero nos dejó deuda técnica.

examples.english: If you never pay technical debt, it compounds every sprint.
examples.spanish: Si nunca pagas la deuda técnica, se acumula cada sprint.

expressions.explanation: A small correction released quickly to fix a serious problem in production, normally skipping the normal release cycle.

examples.english: We shipped a hotfix for the payment bug within the hour.
examples.spanish: Publicamos un parche urgente para el fallo de pago en menos de una hora.

examples.english: A hotfix is not a substitute for a proper test.
examples.spanish: Un parche urgente no sustituye a un test adecuado.

expressions.meaning: test inestable, test que falla a veces
expressions.explanation: A test that passes and fails without any change in the code, usually because it depends on time, order or the network.

examples.english: This test is flaky: it fails once every twenty runs.
examples.spanish: Este test es inestable: falla una de cada veinte ejecuciones.

examples.english: We quarantined two flaky tests until somebody fixes them.
examples.spanish: Pusimos en cuarentena dos tests inestables hasta que alguien los arregle.

expressions.explanation: A test that exercises the whole system the way a user does, from the interface to the database.

examples.english: One end-to-end test covers the whole checkout flow.
examples.spanish: Un test de extremo a extremo cubre todo el proceso de compra.

examples.english: End-to-end tests are slow, so we run them only at night.
examples.spanish: Los tests de extremo a extremo son lentos, así que los ejecutamos solo por la noche.

expressions.explanation: An unusual input or situation at the limit of what the system should handle, such as an empty list or a very long string.

examples.english: An empty list is an edge case we never tested.
examples.spanish: Una lista vacía es un caso límite que nunca probamos.

examples.english: Every edge case in this flow is documented here.
examples.spanish: Todos los casos límite de este flujo están documentados aquí.

expressions.meaning: cuello de botella, punto de bloqueo
expressions.explanation: The single step that limits how fast the whole process can go. Originally a physical narrow part of a bottle.

examples.english: Manual review is the bottleneck in our release process.
examples.spanish: La revisión manual es el cuello de botella de nuestro proceso de publicación.

examples.english: We doubled the servers and the bottleneck moved to the database.
examples.spanish: Duplicamos los servidores y el cuello de botella pasó a la base de datos.

expressions.meaning: caudal, rendimiento (trabajo por unidad de tiempo)
expressions.explanation: How much work a system finishes in a period of time. High throughput is not the same as low latency.

examples.english: Batching improved throughput but increased latency.
examples.spanish: El procesamiento por lotes mejoró el caudal pero aumentó la latencia.

examples.english: The goal was a throughput of ten thousand events per second.
examples.spanish: El objetivo era un caudal de diez mil eventos por segundo.

expressions.meaning: expansión del alcance, proyecto que se agranda
expressions.explanation: When the requirements of a project keep growing while the deadline stays the same.

examples.english: Scope creep turned a two-week task into a two-month project.
examples.spanish: La expansión del alcance convirtió una tarea de dos semanas en un proyecto de dos meses.

examples.english: Writing down what is out of scope is the best cure for scope creep.
examples.spanish: Anotar qué queda fuera es el mejor remedio contra la expansión del alcance.

expressions.meaning: mal olor de código, señal de mal diseño
expressions.explanation: Something in the code that does not break it today but suggests a design problem, such as duplicated logic.

examples.english: Duplicated validation is a code smell, not a pattern.
examples.spanish: La validación duplicada es un mal olor de código, no un patrón.

examples.english: The reviewer flagged two code smells in the same class.
examples.spanish: El revisor señaló dos malos olores de código en la misma clase.

expressions.meaning: error de uno en los límites (índice incorrecto)
expressions.explanation: A classic bug where a loop or an index goes one step too far, usually a list that ends with an exception.

examples.english: An off-by-one error made the loop read past the last element.
examples.spanish: Un error de uno en los límites hizo que el bucle leyera más allá del último elemento.

examples.english: Two of the failing tests were plain off-by-one errors.
examples.spanish: Dos de los tests que fallaban eran simples errores de índice.

expressions.meaning: traza de la pila de llamadas
expressions.explanation: The list of function calls that were running when a program failed, printed when it crashes.

examples.english: The stack trace shows the failure inside the parser.
examples.spanish: La traza de la pila muestra el fallo dentro del parser.

examples.english: Read the stack trace from the bottom up to find the caller.
examples.spanish: Lee la traza de abajo arriba para encontrar quién la llamó.

expressions.meaning: manual de operaciones, guía de intervención
expressions.explanation: A document that lists, step by step, what to do when an incident happens or a routine task must be repeated.

examples.english: The runbook says to disable the feature flag first.
examples.spanish: El manual de operaciones dice que hay que desactivar primero la bandera de funcionalidad.

examples.english: Every production database needs a runbook.
examples.spanish: Toda base de datos en producción necesita un manual de operaciones.

expressions.explanation: Being responsible for a system outside normal hours, in case an incident happens.

examples.english: I'm on call this weekend, so I keep my phone nearby.
examples.spanish: Estoy de guardia este fin de semana, así que llevo el móvil cerca.

examples.english: The on-call rotation gives each person one week in four.
examples.spanish: La rotación de guardia da a cada persona una semana de cada cuatro.

expressions.meaning: reunión diaria de pie, reunión de estado
expressions.explanation: A short daily meeting where each person says what they did, what they will do and what blocks them.

examples.english: Keep the standup short and keep it standing up.
examples.spanish: Mantén la reunión breve y hazla de pie.

examples.english: We discuss architecture after the standup, not during it.
examples.spanish: Discutimos la arquitectura después de la reunión diaria, no durante ella.

expressions.explanation: A meeting at the end of an iteration to look back at what worked and what did not, and agree on changes.

examples.english: In the retrospective we agreed to cap work in progress.
examples.spanish: En la retrospectiva acordamos limitar el trabajo en curso.

examples.english: A retrospective without concrete actions is just a chat.
examples.spanish: Una retrospectiva sin acciones concretas es solo una charla.

expressions.meaning: bandera de funcionalidad, interruptor de funcionalidad
expressions.explanation: A switch in the code that turns a feature on or off without deploying again, often used to test safely.

examples.english: We released it behind a feature flag for 10% of users.
examples.spanish: Lo lanzamos tras una bandera de funcionalidad para el 10 % de usuarios.

examples.english: Remove the feature flag once the new flow is stable.
examples.spanish: Retira la bandera cuando el flujo nuevo sea estable.

expressions.explanation: To apply only some commits from a branch. The verb pick is also used in reviews: pick the best ideas.

examples.english: We cherry-picked the security fix onto the release branch.
examples.spanish: Seleccionamos la corrección de seguridad en la rama de publicación.

examples.english: Cherry-picking a fix without its tests is a recipe for drift.
examples.spanish: Seleccionar una corrección sin sus tests es una receta para divergir.

expressions.explanation: A short piece of work whose only goal is to answer an open question or reduce uncertainty before committing to a solution.

examples.english: We did a two-day spike to see if the library could work for us.
examples.spanish: Hicimos un sondeo de dos días para ver si la librería nos servía.

examples.english: A spike is not a prototype: it answers a question and ends.
examples.spanish: Un sondeo no es un prototipo: responde a una pregunta y termina.

expressions.explanation: Code written long ago that still runs and that nobody dares to touch, usually without tests.

examples.english: The billing module is legacy code with no tests at all.
examples.spanish: El módulo de facturación es código heredado sin ningún test.

examples.english: Wrap legacy code before you replace it.
examples.spanish: Envuelve el código heredado antes de sustituirlo.
